name: Fat Pack | 4g Prepackaged Flower | Lemon Cherry Gelato
description: Fat Pack: The Original 4 Gram Eighth – a half gram better. This fan favorite crosses Sunset Sherbet x Girl Scout Cookies to deliver a happy, uplifting, and relaxing high. Bursting with citrusy, creamy dessert flavors accented by herbal notes, Lemon Cherry Gelato owes its profile to terpenes like Limonene, Terpinolene, and Humulene. Ideal for enhancing creativity and mood, it’s a perfect anytime strain.
